text: DEFONEOS — DWP Child Maintenance AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Article 50 DEFONEOS × DWP × CHILD MAINTENANCE DWP Child Maintenance AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK child maintenance — Child Maintenance Service (CMS) case management, income assessment, enforcement, appeals, arrears recovery, and the Child Poverty Unit. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 5 Backbone Orgs 🏛️ 12 Entry Points Case Management CMS Direct Pay & Collect & Pay Child Maintenance Service two-tier model. Direct Pay (800K+ arrangements) and Collect & Pay (150K+ cases). Income assessment from HMRC data. Calculation engine (CS3 formula). Payment distribution. 950,000+ active cases. Income HMRC Income Data Integration Real-time earnings data from PAYE and Self-Assessment. Gross income calculation. Pension deduction treatment. Benefit income recognition. Multiple employment aggregation. Variable income averaging. 950K+ income assessments annually. Enforcement CMS Enforcement & Compliance Deduction from earnings orders (DEO). Liability orders and charging orders. Deduction from bank accounts. Passport/ driving licence curfew orders. Imprisonment (last resort). 45,000+ enforcement actions annually. Arrears CMS Arrears Management & Recovery £3.7B+ historical arrears. Arrears negotiation and write-off governance. Debt collection agency referral. Time-to-pay arrangements. Bankruptcy proceedings (last resort). Cross-border arrears recovery. Appeals HMCTS First-tier Tribunal (Social Entitlement) Child maintenance decision appeals. Variation applications (lifestyle inconsistency, diversion of income, assets). Upper Tribunal referrals. 15,000+ appeals annually. Independent tribunal judiciary. Shared Care Shared Care & Parental Responsibility Shared care percentage calculation. Overnight stay verification. Equal shared care nil assessment. Care pattern change notification. Multiple case family linking. 200K+ shared care arrangements. International Cross-Border Maintenance Recovery Reciprocal enforcement of maintenance orders (REMO). Hague Convention cases. EU Maintenance Regulation post-Brexit. Central Authority coordination. Foreign court order registration. 12,000+ international cases. Child Poverty Child Poverty Unit & Social Mobility Commission Child poverty measurement (relative and absolute). Persistent poverty tracking. Area-based deprivation modelling. Family income dynamics. Intergenerational poverty breaking. 4.3M children in poverty (after housing costs). Safeguarding Domestic Abuse & Safeguarding Gateway Apply Direct pathway for DA survivors. Section 287 bypass. Safeguarding referral integration. Third-party deduction governance. Address confidentiality protection. 30K+ DA-gateway applications annually. Self-Service CMS Digital Self-Service & GOV.UK Online maintenance calculation tool. Self-service case management. Digital communication preference. Payment tracking portal. Change of circumstances reporting. 2M+ digital transactions annually. Data CMS Analytics & Performance Data Lab CMS operational performance analytics. Collection rate monitoring. Case lifecycle modelling. Arrears trajectory forecasting. Cross-department data sharing (HMRC, DWP, HMCTS). Compliance trend analysis. Parliamentary Work & Pensions Select Committee CMS performance scrutiny. Arrears reduction accountability. Enforcement effectiveness review. Child poverty strategy oversight. Maintenance calculation fairness. NAO value-for-money audits. ⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities 1. Income Assessment Intelligence AI-powered income verification from HMRC PAYE and SA data. Multi-employment aggregation. Self-employment income prediction. Pension and benefit treatment. Variable income smoothing. 950K+ assessments annually with reduced error rates. 2. Arrears Recovery Optimisation Intelligent arrears triage across £3.7B outstanding. Predictive paymen
